items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: whenever we were having a rehearsal with our World of Trombones. The bass trombone player, Douglas Purviance

ctx.x: It has that quality that I used to all the time recognize whenever we were having a rehearsal with our World of Trombones. The bass trombone player, Douglas Purviance, his first note every day would be beautiful. The attack was very clear, and the sound was clear. The other trombone players had to warm up. The first notes usually sounded like there was some stress and strain in them. The bass trombone player never had that. He came in right away with a clear note that had a wonderful duration and an end. That was…
Is it the fact that you can change the bells on this trombone?
